newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels files shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels files shelf registration.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said on Monday that it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $700 million in equity or debt securities.
The company, which owns and operates mid-market to luxury hotels, said it intended to use proceeds from the registration for general corporate purposes, including repayment of debt and acquisitions.
The filing included roughly 4.5 million common shares held by non-employee shareholders, the company said in a statement.
